name: How do I prepare my home for a renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for a renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for a renovation, first remove all personal items, valuables, and furniture from the work area. Cover any remaining furniture or built-ins with protective sheeting to shield them from dust and debris. If necessary, arrange for temporary storage. Ensure clear access for workers and materials, and inform your contractor of any specific concerns or access limitations. It's also wise to secure pets and children away from the construction zone for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, protecting furniture, ensuring contractor access, and securing pets and children.
